{{Infobox character |games =FOTV |image =FOTV Vault 31 Cryobay.png |race =[[Human]] |gender =Female |family = |location =[[Vault 31]] |role =Junior executive |affiliation =[[Vault 31]]/[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |TV actor = |dod = |dod verified= }} '''Christyn Mari''' is a pre-War junior executive of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] who is currently preserved in [[Vault 31]]. ==Background== Mari was a Vault-Tec junior employee selected to participate in [[Bud Askins]]' executive assistant training program "[[Bud's Buds]]," a plan to create "super managers" who would define the future of humanity after the [[Great War]] wiped out all competitors to Vault-Tec. Mari and the other Buds would be kept in [[Cryonics|cryostasis]] in Vault 31, periodically thawed out, and transferred to [[Vault 32]] or [[Vault 33|33]] to manage the dwellers and participate in controlled breeding (eugenics), all under Askins' supervision.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"So what's Vault 32 and 33? Just people to be controlled?"''
[[Bud Askins]]: ''"What? No! When you put it like that, it sounds downright morally questionable. They're our breeding pool, the ultimate expression of HR R&D. Genetically selected to breed with my Buds to create a class of super managers. People with positivity, people who make lemonade. People who will inherit the Earth after we've wiped the surface clean."''

She had a pet cat which she ironically named Puppy, entirely on purpose.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"You okay?"''
Claudia: ''Sorry. You'd think it would have all hit me at once, but, uh... (sniffling) Nope. (sighs) Even if my parents survived the bombs, they'd be gone by now. Same with my friends. My cat. (sniffling)"''
Norm: ''"Your cat have a name?"''
Claudia: ''"His name was Puppy."''
Norm: ''"Puppy the cat."''
Claudia: ''"It's funny, huh?"''
Norm: ''"I mean, not right now, I guess."''
Claudia: ''"(inhales sharply) Yeah."''

The next day, Elder Cleric Quintus interrogates aspirant [[Maximus]] for injuring the newly promoted squire [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]]. After, he exonerates him and anoints him as squire to [[Titus|Knight Titus]].
